snippet.title: The Bell Tolls - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist and request playtest access on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5123990/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=announce&utm_content=gameplaytrailer
Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/2vmMtDsMV

Playtest signups are open! The playtest starts in December.

The Bell Tolls is a turn-based party roguelike RPG with the 5e tabletop ruleset. 
Every midnight the Bell tolls and the Corruption spreads. Gather your party and venture forth to destroy the source before the Corruption reaches town.

Coming to PC (Steam) in 2027.

#roguelike #5e #indiegame
